subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about paid-subscriber growth for {Brand}. Education stays one of the slowest-converting categories: download-to-paid by day 35 lands at 2.3% of installs, and a 12-month LTV of $45.10 ranks third across categories, so a renewing payer is earned slowly and worth defending. With hard paywalls converting trials at 12.11% against 2.18% on freemium gating, the paywall test is where most of the upside sits. We hold out a control group so the paid subscriptions read as incremental to your organic sign-ups. Worth comparing against your current mix?
angle: fresh angle: slow-converting education funnel (sourced D35 + LTV + paywall band) + incrementality
register_notes: Stage 2 EN education: acknowledges 2nd follow-up + references prior email; fresh angle = education funnel economics (download-to-paid D35 2.3%; 12-month LTV $45.10 third across categories; hard-paywall trial-to-paid 12.11% vs 2.18% freemium), all verified market context carried from the parent's RevenueCat sources in enrichment_sources, never attributed to MobUpps; MobUpps holdout reference (no figure); 1 question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; X-not-Y avoided; only parent brand set used (no Duolingo or out-of-set brand named).
